evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifts monotonically upward during growth, 3.01→3.25 Torr (k=21→25), while Ar setpoint/flow is steady at 100 sccm
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from commanded flow
Thermocouple holds 750 °C with plausible heater power (~45%); thermal control looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed — atmosphere purity cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a leak-up/pump-down test: close Ar and watch pressure — rise implies seal leak, fall implies flow-side restriction) to distinguish a seal leak from partial exhaust blockage.
